proof-narrative-lean-equiv.evidence: S↔L: ref is sibling-only (no library decl). The md (md:1-16) states an evaluation formula for 𝔪(ϱ) with the pair sum over all 0≤i<j≤n-2. The Lean instead (a) takes that formula as a definition (`massPoly`, lean:81-85), so the claimed value is a definition, and (b) proves a different proposition, positivity (lean:140-143), which the md never states. (c) The pair sum runs only over adjacent pairs `∑ i : Fin (n - 1)` with V(i)·V(i+1) (lean:67-69, 85), not over all i<j. (d) It indexes V by Fin n where the md has n-1 generators. Positivity rests on the extra hypothesis `li2q_nonpos_on_neg : ∀ x, 0 ≤ x → li2q (-x) ≤ 0` (lean:103), stated for every x ≥ 0. The series in md:16, Σ z^n/(n[n]_q), has finite radius (about q), so the md's own Li₂^q cannot satisfy it globally. S↔P: there is no derivation of the "mass =" formula; the prf is model narrative. Problems: (1) "their combined weight is z², not 2z²" (prf:72) is asserted, though each of σ_iσ_{i+1} and σ_{i+1}σ_i has tr_M = z². (2) "triples and higher generator subsets are not independent at level n" (prf:61-62) is false as algebra: σ_0σ_1σ_2 is a reduced-word basis element of H_4 (the NF basis is linearly independent). (3) The statement carries an empirical claim, md:20: "The Faddeev Φ_q form was empirically incompatible with isospin symmetry at q_0 and created massive mirror-nucleus pathologies". The q-dilog subproof (prf:23-43) is correct.

No theorem derives the formula or the z^2 pair weight 'from the Markov-trace factorization' (md:20). V i, frobeniusNorm and li2q are abstract data, and the sign on [0,rho) and rho itself are hypotheses. The Lean module docstring still carries the empirical 'refuted ... isospin symmetry; mirror-nucleus pathologies' sentence (comment only). No photon/electron ruling conflict.
